# What a Sharp install holds, relative to the build's prefix (zig-out).
# A path ending in / is a folder copied whole. Read by stage.sh (for
# package.sh and release.sh) and by install-dev.ps1.
bin/sharp.exe
bin/conpty.dll
bin/OpenConsole.exe
bin/WebView2Loader.dll
bin/OpenConsoleProxy.dll
bin/sharp-mcp.exe
share/terminfo/ghostty.terminfo
share/licenses/conpty/LICENSE.txt
share/licenses/sharp/LICENSE.txt
share/licenses/webview2/LICENSE.txt
share/licenses/thesvg/LICENSE.txt
share/ghostty/themes/
share/ghostty/shell-integration/
